name: Tazarotene

lead: Tazarotene is a prescription acetylenic topical retinoid approved for acne vulgaris, plaque psoriasis and, in cream form, for facial fine wrinkling and pigment irregularities from sun damage. It is generally considered one of the most potent topical retinoids.

Its potency makes it a choice for stubborn acne and photodamage, but also makes irritation a frequent limiting factor, so newer lotion and foam formulations and combinations with other agents have been developed.

paras: Tazarotene is a prodrug converted in the skin to tazarotenic acid, which selectively binds retinoic acid receptors beta and gamma. This normalizes keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, reduces inflammation and influences genes involved in skin repair, producing improvements in acne lesions, psoriatic plaques and photoaged skin.

Local irritation, dryness, peeling and photosensitivity are common. Tazarotene carries a boxed pregnancy warning in some labels because of teratogenicity concerns, and pregnancy testing and contraception are advised for people who could become pregnant. It requires a prescription.
